reference_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per month with sales
  SELECT order_month AS month, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY order_month
), months AS (
  -- one row per month of the range
  SELECT DISTINCT month_start AS month
  FROM calendar
  WHERE cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
), filled AS (
  -- one row per month of the range
  SELECT ms.month, COALESCE(m.units, 0) AS units
  FROM months ms
  LEFT JOIN monthly m ON m.month = ms.month
)
SELECT month, units,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 3
       THEN ROUND(AVG(units) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2)
  END AS avg_units_3m
FROM filled

WITH filled AS (
  -- one row per month of the range
  SELECT c.month_start AS month, COALESCE(SUM(s.units), 0) AS units
  FROM calendar c
  LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.order_date = c.cal_date
  WHERE c.cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY c.month_start
)

WITH grid AS (
  SELECT CAST(mo AS DATE) AS month
  FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2025-06-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS g(mo)
), monthly AS (
  SELECT CAST(order_month AS DATE) AS month, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY CAST(order_month AS DATE)
), j AS (
  SELECT g.month, COALESCE(m.units, 0) AS units
  FROM grid g LEFT JOIN monthly m ON m.month = g.month
)
SELECT month, units,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 3
    THEN ROUND(AVG(units) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) END AS avg_units_3m
FROM j
